Name: RUNTIME_SOUND_PARAM_ST
Description: Sounds played at runtime when a condition is met: each row plays a sound effect in a slot, optionally attached to a dummy poly and setting an RTPC value.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Network Test Version
Fields.Description: Exclude from the NT version or mark the ones to be excluded.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Release Version
Fields.Description: Exclude from the product version or mark the items to be excluded.

Fields.Name: Condition ID
Fields.Description: ID identifying the condition for this sound.

Fields.Name: Playback Slot Number
Fields.Description: Slot number the sound plays in.

Fields.Name: Attach Dummy Poly ID
Fields.Description: Dummy poly ID the sound effect is attached to when it plays.

Fields.Name: Apply to Enemy and Allied ACs
Fields.Description: Whether this also applies to enemy and allied ACs. Only for player rows; ignored for NPC rows.

Fields.Name: Sound Type
Fields.Description: Sets whether the sound is a normal event, a dynamic dialogue line, and so on.

Fields.Name: RTPC [1] Value Change Time
Fields.Description: Time for RTPC 1 to reach the set value. In milliseconds.

Fields.Name: Sound Effect ID: Other Characters
Fields.Description: Sound effect ID used for characters other than the player's own AC.
